ASGCostEntry.description: One sparse cost: assigning ROW to COLUMN costs COST.

DENSE_COST.description:
Dense cost matrix, row-major, ROWS * COLUMNS values. NaN or +Infinity
marks a forbidden pair. Empty when ENTRIES gives the problem.

ENTRIES.description:
Sparse costs; a pair not listed is forbidden. When a pair repeats, the
lowest cost stands. Empty when DENSE_COST gives the problem.

UNASSIGNED_COST.description:
Cost of leaving a row unassigned: empty means every row must be assigned
(then ROWS <= COLUMNS); one value applies to every row; ROWS values give
one per row. In gated association this is the gate.

ROW_IDS.description:
Optional labels of the rows (e.g. observation identifiers), ROWS entries
or empty.

COLUMN_IDS.description:
Optional labels of the columns (e.g. object keys), COLUMNS entries or
empty.

ASGSolution.description: The optimal assignment of a problem.

ROWS.description: Number of rows of the problem.

COLUMNS.description: Number of columns of the problem.

ASSIGNMENT.description: Column assigned to each row, ROWS entries; -1 = unassigned.

TOTAL_COST.description: Sum of the assigned costs plus the unassigned costs paid.

ASSIGNED.description: Number of rows assigned to a real column.

METHOD.description:
Algorithm, e.g. "Hungarian (shortest augmenting path with potentials)",
"auction", "JVC".

KEY.description:
The key the solver used for the object: its OBJECT_ID, else
"NORAD:<n>", else its name.

OBJECT_ID.description: International designator or provider object identifier; empty = none.

ASGMeasurement.description: One measured quantity of an observation.

VALUE.description: Measured value: km, km/s or degrees by KIND.

SIGMA.description: One-sigma uncertainty, same unit as VALUE; positive.

SOURCE_FIELD.description:
The field of the source record the value came from, e.g. "RANGE",
"RANGE_RATE", "DOPPLER", "RA", "DECLINATION", "AZIMUTH", "ELEVATION".

ASGCandidate.description: One predicted object tested against an observation.

D2.description:
Mahalanobis distance squared of the residual on S = H P H' + R
(dimensionless, chi-square distributed with the observation's degrees
of freedom).

POSTERIOR.description:
Posterior association probability among the observation's candidates and
clutter, 0 to 1.

IN_GATE.description: True when D2 is within the observation's gate.

LOG_DET_S.description: Natural logarithm of det(S), in the measurement units' product.

RESIDUAL.description:
Residuals, measured minus predicted, one per observation MEASUREMENTS
entry in the same order and unit (angles wrapped to +-180 degrees).

PREDICTED.description: Predicted values, one per observation MEASUREMENTS entry.

LIGHT_TIME_S.description: One-way light time applied, s; 0 = none.

POSITION_GCRF_KM.description:
Predicted position at the observation time, GCRF, km (3 values); empty
when geometry was not requested.

VELOCITY_GCRF_KM_S.description: Predicted velocity, GCRF, km/s (3 values); empty when not requested.

POSITION_COVARIANCE_KM2.description:
Predicted position covariance, GCRF, km**2, 3x3 row-major (9 values);
empty when not requested.

INDEX.description: Position of the observation in the input, 0-based.

RECORD_TYPE.description:
Standard of the observation record, as its code, e.g. "RDO", "EOO",
"RFO".

TIME.description: Observation time, UTC, ISO 8601 as the record states it.

SENSOR.description: Sensor identifier (the record's sensor or original sensor id).

TRACK_ID.description: Track identifier from the record; empty = none.

MEASUREMENTS.description:
The measured quantities, in the order every candidate's RESIDUAL and
PREDICTED follow.

DEGREES_OF_FREEDOM.description: Degrees of freedom of the test (the number of MEASUREMENTS).

GATE.description: Gate threshold on D2 for this observation.

AMBIGUOUS.description:
True when the judged candidate's posterior is under the minimum
posterior, or the assignment gave the observation other than its best
candidate.

ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT.description:
True when the assignment gave the observation other than its best
in-gate candidate.

CANDIDATES.description:
Candidates by increasing D2: the best few plus every in-gate one. The
first is the nearest (the one a UCT report names).

ASSIGNED_CANDIDATE.description: Index into CANDIDATES of the assigned object; -1 = uncorrelated.

SENSOR_POSITION_GCRF_KM.description: Sensor position at the observation time, GCRF, km (3 values).

SENSOR_VELOCITY_GCRF_KM_S.description:
Sensor velocity, GCRF, km/s (3 values) for an Earth-fixed sensor; empty
for an inertial sensor position, which carries no velocity.

LINE_OF_SIGHT_GCRF.description:
Unit line of sight from the sensor, GCRF (3 values); empty when the
observation has no direction.

ASGAssociationOptions.description: Settings of a gated association. Every field has its default.

GATE_PROBABILITY.description: Probability mass inside the chi-square gate, (0, 1).

MIN_POSTERIOR.description: Minimum posterior for an unambiguous association, (0, 1].

CLUTTER_DENSITY.description:
Spatial density of clutter (false or new-object detections) in the
posterior, per unit measurement volume; 0 = none.

MAX_CANDIDATES.description: Out-of-gate candidates reported per observation, 1 to 50.

GEOMETRY.description: Report each candidate's predicted position, velocity and covariance.

ASGGateThreshold.description: Chi-square gate threshold for one number of degrees of freedom.

THRESHOLD.description: D2 threshold at the gate probability.

ASGAssociationReport.description:
The evidence of one association run. The association list and the
uncorrelated list are OBSERVATIONS filtered by OUTCOME.

METHOD.description:
Method, e.g. "chi-square gate on S = H P H^T + R, global nearest
neighbour per scan (Hungarian), gate as the non-assignment cost".

OPTIONS.description: The options the run used, defaults filled in.

GATE_THRESHOLDS.description: Gate thresholds by degrees of freedom.

ASG.description: Assignment - exactly one of the arms is set.
